preferredSourceOrder: World Bank or other public intergovernmental dataset

tourismIntensity.estimand: Annual overnight visitor arrivals divided by resident population for the same destination geography and a stated reference year. A strict record satisfies that estimand exactly; a relaxed record departs from it only in the ways named in relaxationReasons and must be separable from strict records in every downstream use.
preferredSourceOrder: official national tourism statistics with destination table

bands.unknown: No comparable public numerator and denominator retained

evidenceGrades.strict: Same-geography, full-period, all-visitor overnight arrivals with an exact published numerator.
evidenceGrades.relaxed: Accepted under the Phase 6C throughput exception with every departure named; excludable from model fitting and required to be reported separately.

relaxationReasons.geography_approximate: Numerator covers a province, region, or destination area larger than the planner city.
relaxationReasons.numerator_partial: Numerator omits a visitor segment (for example international-only) or mixes overnight and same-day visits.
relaxationReasons.numerator_rounded: Source publishes a rounded headline figure rather than an exact count.
relaxationReasons.reference_year_stale: Numerator and denominator reference years differ, or the denominator predates the numerator.

tourismIntensity.populationSourceName: Chiang Rai province population, from the Thailand Department of Provincial Administration registered-population December snapshot
tourismIntensity.notes: The retrieved report presents 6,193,932 as a single aggregate and does not separate overnight tourists from same-day excursionists, so the numerator is not demonstrably overnight-only and will overstate the registered estimand. The geography is the province rather than Chiang Rai city. The denominator is a registered-population snapshot reached through a tertiary page citing the Department of Provincial Administration; replace both terms with a direct Ministry of Tourism and Sports provincial table and a direct DOPA table before any strict use.

screenedSources.name: Hanoi Statistics Office, socio-economic report for Q4 and full-year 2024
Hanoi city portal, tourism-sector 2024 results and 2025 tasks

tourismIntensity.notes: Hanoi Statistics reports 6.466 million guests served by accommodation establishments in 2024, including 1.120 million domestic overnight guests and 834,000 domestic day guests, but it does not split the 4.512 million international accommodation guests by overnight status. The Hanoi Department of Tourism separately reports 4.47 million international visitors with stays, but does not publish a domestic overnight component in the same series. Combining the department's international count with the statistics office's domestic count would splice two non-reconciled systems whose international totals differ. Retain tourism intensity as pending rather than treating every international accommodation guest as overnight or merging the two systems.

screenedSources.name: Ministry of Hotels and Tourism Myanmar, Statistics
TTG Asia, Myanmar recovery still a long way, reporting Ministry of Hotels and Tourism figures

tourismIntensity.notes: The Ministry of Hotels and Tourism publishes arrivals at Yangon International Airport (240,219 in 2023) and national foreign tourist totals, but no all-visitor overnight arrivals series for Yangon Region or Yangon city. Airport arrivals include residents and transit passengers and exclude overland and domestic visitors, which is the same defect that blocked Medellin. Retain as missing rather than treating a gateway passenger count as destination arrivals.

screenedSources.name: BPS-Statistics Indonesia Bali Province, Number of Foreign Visitor to Bali and Indonesia
BPS-Statistics Indonesia Bali Province, Number of Domestic Tourist Trips by Destination Regency/Municipality

tourismIntensity.notes: BPS Bali publishes foreign visitor arrivals and domestic tourist trips at province level; neither is available for Ubud or for Gianyar Regency as an overnight-arrivals series. The domestic series counts perjalanan wisatawan nusantara (tourist trips), which includes same-day visits, so combining it with the foreign series would not yield overnight arrivals. The province-level resident denominator table returned HTTP 403 at capture time and only derived secondary population figures were available, so no same-year official denominator could be retained. Reject rather than pairing a province numerator with an unsourced population.

tourismIntensity.notes: The planner destination is Goa state, so the state numerator and denominator are geographically aligned even though Goa has no single-city size match. The numerator sums 9,941,286 domestic and 467,911 foreign tourist arrivals. The public table does not document its overnight filter, accommodation coverage, or repeat-visit deduplication inline; retain the official tourist-arrival series as a destination-pressure proxy rather than a unique-person census.

tourismIntensity.notes: India's Ministry of Tourism publishes Domestic Tourist Visits and Foreign Tourist Visits for the Delhi National Capital Territory, but the screened official tables do not isolate overnight arrivals. These are visit series furnished by the State/UT administration, not a registered-accommodation guest-arrival count, and the project does not assume every visit includes an overnight stay. Retain tourism intensity as pending rather than summing DTV and FTV into the registered numerator.
